declarations.comments: `Compose f g` is the composition of the two functors `f` and `g`.
declarations.title: Compose

declarations.comments: `Coproduct f g` is the coproduct of two functors `f` and `g`
declarations.title: Coproduct

declarations.comments:
Eliminate a coproduct by providing eliminators for the left and
right components
declarations.title: coproduct

declarations.comments: Change the underlying functors in a coproduct
declarations.title: bihoistCoproduct

declarations.comments:
`Costar` turns a `Functor` into a `Profunctor` "backwards".

`Costar f` is also the co-Kleisli category for `f`.
declarations.title: Costar

declarations.comments: Flips the order of the type arguments of a `Bifunctor`.
declarations.title: Flip

declarations.comments: `Product f g` is the product of the two functors `f` and `g`.
declarations.title: Product

declarations.comments:
The product of two types that both take two type parameters (e.g. `Either`,
`Tuple, etc.) where both type parameters are the same.

```purescript
Product2 (Tuple 4 true) (Right false) :: Product2 Tuple Either Int Boolean
Product2 (Tuple 4 true) (Left      8) :: Product2 Tuple Either Int Boolean
```
declarations.title: Product2
